briefdescription.para: REST controller for service-directory entities (clinics, pharmacies, laboratories, centers).

detaileddescription.para: This file defines the Services controller, which manages the directory of service providers through create, read, update, delete and search endpoints. The {serviceType} part of the URL (clinics, pharmacies, laboratories or radiologycenters) selects one concrete ServiceController from a std::variant registry. Depending on the configuration each handler either awaits an async controller coroutine or uses executeControllerMethod for blocking database work. Handlers translate the controller's numeric result into a standard JSON HTTP response and build a Requester from the identity attributes inserted by Auth.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This controller is the HTTP front door for the service directory. Drogon routes the /api/v2 service URLs here; the handlers call the shared dispatcher, which in turn calls the service controllers and entities and finally the database. It relies on Auth for caller identity and on the service locator for the executor and controllers. Without it clients could not add, browse, edit or search the clinics, pharmacies, labs and centers listed in the system.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
REST create/read/update/delete (CRUD) routes: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods
std::variant (a type-safe union): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/utility/variant
HTTP filters/middleware: https://drogon.docsforge.com/master/filter/
CORS: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/CORS
